methodologyNotes: Roster covers fourteen dual-action (random-orbit) car polishers spanning budget import, mainstream DIY, and professional-detailer tiers, verified 2026-08-01 primarily against manufacturer product pages (rupes.com, griotsgarage.com, portercable.com, meguiars.com, flexpowertools.com, harborfreight.com, adamspolishes.com, chemicalguys.com, ryobitools.com) supplemented by authorized-retailer listings (Home Depot, Walmart, Summit Racing, JB Tools, 44Tools, Panda Motorworks, ProToolReviews) where the manufacturer site did not publish a full spec sheet or blocked automated access. 'action_type' distinguishes free-spinning random-orbit designs (pad rotation can stall under heavy pressure, e.g. Rupes, Flex) from gear-driven/forced-rotation designs (pad rotation is mechanically fixed to the orbit, e.g. Griot's, Porter-Cable, Meguiar's, Chemical Guys, Bauer, Ryobi) — both families are marketed and bought as 'dual-action' polishers by the target buyer. Adversarial corrections to the seed list: DeWalt DWP849X was DROPPED — it is a rotary (single-action, forced-rotation-only, no counter-oscillation) polisher per DeWalt's own product page, not a dual-action/random-orbit tool, so it does not belong in this category and no substitute DeWalt model exists in this segment. 'Bauer 20V Cordless' was CORRECTED: Harbor Freight's actual 20V cordless Bauer buffers (items 56721/56722) are single-speed, forced-rotation 'Orbital Polisher/Buffer' units that Harbor Freight does NOT brand or document as dual-action; the only Bauer/Harbor Freight polisher explicitly sold and labeled as a 'DA Polisher' is the corded BAUER 7.5 Amp 6 in. 20mm Long-Throw Random Orbit DA Polisher (item 56367), which was substituted in. Roster was expanded beyond the seed list with the RUPES Mille LK900E (finishing/low-orbit segment), Griot's Garage G21 (long-throw) and G8 Mini (compact/3-in segment), Chemical Guys TORQ22D (extra-large-throw), and Ryobi ONE+ PBF100 (mainstream cordless) for fuller 2026 buyer-comparison coverage. Prices are current US street/list price for the bare tool (or tool+starter-kit where no bare-tool SKU is sold) as of accessedAt; several boutique/detailing brands (RUPES, Adam's, Chemical Guys) do not sell direct to consumers or publish a fixed consumer MSRP, so priceUsd reflects a representative authorized-retailer price with the spread noted in priceNote. Weight, cord length, and full OPM range were genuinely unpublished for several budget and mini models and are recorded as null rather than estimated.

products.name: RUPES BigFoot LHR21 Mark III Random Orbital Polisher
products.priceNote: RUPES sells only through authorized distributors and sets no fixed consumer MSRP; current US dealer pricing runs ~$465-$490 (used: Professional Detailing Products $490)
products.provenance: RUPES flagship 'big pad' polisher. 21mm orbit, 150mm (6in) backing plate, 500W, 3,000-4,500 speed rating, 9m (30ft) cord, 2.7kg (5.95lb) confirmed on rupes.com official product page. Free-spin (non-gear-driven) mechanism per RUPES BigFoot platform documentation. No official RUPES consumer MSRP exists (distributor-set pricing); price triangulated from an authorized US reseller.

products.name: RUPES BigFoot Mille LK900E Gear-Driven Dual Action Polisher
products.priceNote: Current US dealer street/sale price; RUPES-listed 'regular' price on the same retailer was $712.98
products.provenance: RUPES 'Mille' finishing polisher, a short-throw (5mm) gear-driven dual-action machine used for final-step, low-hologram polishing — distinct mechanism from RUPES's own free-spin BigFoot LHR line, confirmed on rupes.com. 900W, 265-535 rated speed, 125mm/150mm backing plates, 29.5ft cord, 6.17lb, all confirmed on the official RUPES product page. Release year not documented on any source checked.

products.name: Griot's Garage G9 Random Orbital Polisher

Weight not published by the manufacturer or any retailer checked.

products.name: Griot's Garage G21 Long-Throw Orbital Polisher
products.provenance: Griot's large-orbit 'BOSS' long-throw polisher launched via SEMA Show press release Aug 2021. 21mm orbit, 1100W/10A 'big block' motor, 3,000-4,500 OPM, 6in fan-cooled backing plate, 10ft cord, all confirmed on griotsgarage.com. Weight not published by the manufacturer or any retailer checked.

products.name: Porter-Cable 7424XP 6 in. Variable-Speed Random Orbit Polisher

products.name: Bauer 7.5 Amp 6 in. 20mm Long-Throw Random Orbit DA Polisher
products.priceNote: Harbor Freight regular list price (item #56367); frequently discounted 20-40% via store coupons to ~$60-80
